Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing plan membership default provisions in the public employees' retirement system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to plan membership default provisions in the publicemployees' retirement system; and amending RCW 41.40.785.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.40.785 and 2000 c 247 s 302 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All employees who first become employed by an employer in aneligible position on or after March 1, 2002, for state agencies orinstitutes of higher education, or September 1, 2002, for otheremployers, shall have a period of ninety days to make an irrevocablechoice to become a member of plan 2 or plan 3. At the end of ninetydays, if the member has not made a choice to become a member of plan 2,he or she becomes a member of plan 2 or plan 3 as follows: (a) He or she becomes a member of plan 3 if first employed by anemployer in an eligible position on or after March 1, 2002, but priorto July 1, 2009, for state agencies or institutes of higher education,or on or after September 1, 2002, but prior to July 1, 2009, for otheremployers; or (b) He or she becomes a member of plan 2 if first employed by anemployer in an eligible position on or after July 1, 2009. p. 1 HB 1722 (2) For administrative efficiency, until a member elects to becomea member of plan 3, or becomes a member of plan 3 by default pursuantto subsection (1) of this section, the member shall be reported to thedepartment in plan 2, with member and employer contributions. Uponbecoming a member of plan 3 by election or by default, all servicecredit shall be transferred to the member's plan 3 defined benefit, andall employee accumulated contributions shall be transferred to themember's plan 3 defined contribution account.
